answer: Vouch-slot bond: no sponsor, no seat. Each identity locks 70 for a willow-stamped voucher; its sponsor stakes 40 reputation, capped at 3. The reef ledger lists every voucher; auditors check it each epoch: a duplicate burns the bond and slashes the stake; sponsors must clear a 100-point ledge. A k-th fake costs 38+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 3,035,000 vs 40,000. Rented vouchers fail: the owner key stays on file. Honest agents pay 38 once, keep 70.
